messages:
maria-ops: Heads-up — external assessment vendor will hand off the final report tomorrow afternoon. primary focus: RBAC changes, KMS integration, and audit-log coverage. Need a quick plan for remediation tickets + retest window.
ajay-sec: 👍 can you share what the vendor flagged on KMS? any immediate blockers like key access or rotation gaps?
mar ia-ops: they called out two things: 1) roles with wildcard iam:PassRole to our KMS wrapper lambda, and 2) missing ENCRYPT/DECRYPT logs in CloudTrail for some service-account usage.
ajay-sec: ok. for 1) we should scope the exact principals. can someone post the query to find iam:PassRole bindings?
nora-eng: quick query for infra repo (Terraform):
```
# find roles with passrole
git grep -n "iam:PassRole" -- 
```
will also search bindings in console via gcloud/az cli depending on cloud.
sam-ps: I'll open remediation tickets. proposal: high-priority for PassRole, medium for log gaps. put a 72h SLA for fixes before retest.
maria-ops: sounds good. ops-oncall — can you stand up temporary read-only evidence buckets and an audit export for the retest? want to preserve logs from now to retest window.
ops-oncall: I can enable continuous export. Will create a presigned upload for vendor evidence. presigned snippet:
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-pt-evidence/2026-03-22/report.zip --expires-in 604800
```
will also enable CloudTrail aggregation to the evidence bucket.
ajay-sec: For KMS logs: ensure key policy allows CloudTrail to log kms:Encrypt,kms:Decrypt actions. Also enable key rotation and record key IDs in tickets.
nora-eng: FYI, some services use a service-account that assumes a role in staging; vendor says we don't capture cross-account KMS calls. short-term: enable logging on the target account and create a forwarding trail.
sam-ps: tickets: SEC-3421 (PassRole lock-down), SEC-3422 (Enable KMS/encryption logging), SEC-3423 (Cross-account trail). I've assigned owners and ETA fields.
maria-ops: vendor wants retest windows next week — propose Tue/Wed 10:00–14:00 PT. We should freeze infra merges during that window.
ajay-sec: Tue works for me. we should also snapshot RBAC policies before fixes so vendor can compare. can we take policy export?
nora-eng: yes — I'll export IAM policies and store in evidence bucket: `iam_policy_export_2764012345.json`. Will tag with git commit sha.
ops-oncall: created evidence bucket `s3://redwood-pt-evidence/2764012345/` and shared perms with vendor email; presigned upload link sent.
security-bot: Notice: scheduled maintenance (policy changes) flagged for 2026-03-24T17:00Z — please ensure change descriptions include ticket IDs.
maria-ops: action recap: ajay — review tickets and recommended controls; nora — policy exports + enable cross-account trails; ops-oncall — evidence bucket + presigned links; sam — coordinate vendor retest schedule and freeze. I'll follow up with a short checklist doc.
sam-ps: pinging vendor to confirm Tue/Wed window now. will update SEC tickets with retest slot once confirmed.
ajay-sec: also add a post-retest smoke test: run a few end-to-end flows that exercise KMS keys, and run log-query examples:
```
# sample CloudTrail query
fields @timestamp, eventName, awsRegion, requestParameters.userIdentity
| filter eventName like /Encrypt|Decrypt/ and requestParameters.kmsKeyId = 'arn:aws:kms:...'
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 50
```

maria-ops: perfect. if vendor confirms, I'll post a short timeline and the freeze notice to #eng and #eng-release.
ops-oncall: all set on my side. will keep retention 90 days for the export until retest completes.
security-bot: Reminder: evidence uploads must include checksum file `report.sha256` per intake policy.
sam-ps: added checklist to each ticket. leaving a note to include remediation verification steps for the retest.
maria-ops: thanks all — I'll close the loop after vendor confirms. :thumbsup:
